narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional endorsement for 'Tartine' mooncake gift boxes. It uses a comedic dialogue between a father and a baby (represented through subtitles) to highlight the shortcomings of traditional mooncakes (limited variety, short shelf life) and presents the Tartine box as the superior solution with its diverse flavors, attractive packaging, and longer freshness.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product packaging, multiple close-ups of product features, and verbal endorsement of the brand name and gift box variety.
